static_traits.name: Zhao Jing
static_traits.occupation: High school teacher (teaching Japanese and painting)
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy; previously received speech therapy
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, cooperates well, can specifically describe troubles and feelings, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Because of accent and pronunciation difficulties (such as 'hippopotamus'), long feeling inferior and embarrassed, causing shame, tension, and negative self-evaluation when speaking in front of others, affecting career and personal life, self-esteem, and sleep.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inferiority and embarrassment are affecting my professional and personal life, causing distress and affecting my self-esteem, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After relocating for teaching about 10 years ago, received feedback and criticism about accent early in her teaching career; this experience continuously reinforced her high self-focus on accent and negative self-evaluation; since then consistently feeling shame and nervousness about public speaking and difficult-to-pronounce words, with worsening negative self-talk. Tried speech therapy, but it has not yet eased her feelings of 'inferiority/not good enough'.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, unworthy of being a teacher

special_situations.event: Needs to speak publicly or read aloud hard-to-pronounce words in class or staff meetings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I mispronounce or expose my accent in public, others will look down on me, thinking I am unprofessional and unqualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitating or reducing speaking in meetings, deliberately avoiding difficult words, repeatedly over-preparing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I sound stupid, they are laughing at me in their hearts

special_situations.event: Receiving criticism and negative feedback about accent early in teaching career
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One negative feedback proves my accent is a persistent problem, and also shows I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-vigilance about speaking and pronunciation, forming negative self-talk, seeking speech therapy in order to correct the defect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited to be a teacher/I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When with a few friends who know me well or with my pet dog, communication is relatively relaxed and others do not mind the accent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: These positive experiences do not count; only perfect pronunciation in every situation shows I have no problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive evidence, continuing to focus on negative evaluations and risks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They only do not mind because they know me; this does not mean others will not mind

special_situations.event: Interacting with colleagues or students in work settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my pronunciation is not perfect, I will not be respected or taken seriously; others' views determine my worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks comfort and reassurance from others, reduces proactive speaking in meetings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If my pronunciation is not perfect, others will not respect me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and respected, not judged for accent
core_conflict.fear: Fears being ridiculed, looked down on, losing professional image and sense of worth
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by speaking less in public and avoiding difficult words
Maintains self-criticism and high vigilance to try to avoid mistakes and shame

manifestations: Living alone, having only a few friends and not yet sharing inferiority and embarrassment with them
Keeps distance from others at work due to excessive self-consciousness, finding relationships hard to build

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-denial in conversations and narratives (like 'I sound like a fool')
Over-worries about others' opinions, leading to hesitation to speak in meetings
Unwilling to share true inferiority and embarrassment even with a few friends

exception_events.target_problem: In situations requiring public speaking or pronouncing difficult words, the client usually feels strong embarrassment and self-denial, thus anxiously avoiding, affecting communication and performance
exception_events.unique_outcome: When with the pet dog or with a few familiar friends, the client almost no longer focuses on the accent, feeling more relaxed and accepted, communicating more naturally, with significantly reduced shame and nervousness
exception_events.reason: Different situations and relationship support: in safe and accepting relationships (the pet does not judge, friends know and do not mind the accent), judgment threat is significantly reduced and the client's self-criticism temporarily stops

positive_force: Having a few supportive friends and a pet bringing a sense of safety and acceptance
Strong motivation to seek help; has tried speech therapy
Positive attitude, willing to do reality testing and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Excessively cares about others' evaluations and internalizes criticism (mind reading)
Overgeneralization and self-labeling reinforcing the not-good-enough self-schema
Avoidance of talking and reduced speaking in public situations limit occupational and interpersonal development
Affected sleep, worsening anxiety and rumination

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and avoidance when speaking publicly or pronouncing difficult words (hesitating to speak, lower participation)
antecedent: Classroom teaching requiring speaking and demonstration
Needing to speak or respond in staff meetings
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief of 'I am not good enough' formed after being criticized for accent early on, plus catastrophizing/mind-reading anticipation of others' judgments, leading to heightened self-shame and vigilance
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and embarrassed to gain safety and short-term emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Affected work performance, difficulty building relationships with colleagues and students, lowered self-esteem, nighttime rumination affecting sleep
